description: On the green cloth in front are blue plastic dishes: a small plate, a cup, and blue utensils (fork, knife, spoon) arranged like a place setting. The right hand reaches in and moves the small plate to the left side, then lifts the cup onto the plate and drops the fork, knife, and spoon into the cup one by one; afterward both hands grip the green cloth as a two-hand object and fold and smooth it into a smaller rectangle, pushing it slightly forward.
